import os
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u067/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4932efbf.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    color = next((v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0), 0)
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != color or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]==color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append(comp)
    comp=max(comps,key=len)
    r0=min(r for r,c in comp); r1=max(r for r,c in comp)
    c0=min(c for r,c in comp); c1=max(c for r,c in comp)
    return [[grid[r][c] if (r,c) in set(comp) else 0 for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
print(p)
